title: 第26章 大售一空
novel_title: 穿越源卡大陆，我自带融合卡牌
content_zh:
第二日，

    天还没完全亮，奇妙物语商铺前就已经开始大排长龙了。

    “儿子！快起床！再磨蹭会儿，门外那群人怕是要把咱们家铺子给拆了！”

    林峰急匆匆的冲进林奇房间。

    可刚迈过门槛，他的脚步就像被钉在地上，原本急促的呼吸猛地一滞，目光死死黏在桌案上。

    三道截然不同的光华在昏暗里流转，纯净的白、温润的绿，还有一抹如同深海宝石般的蓝，层层叠叠的卡牌铺满了半张桌子。

    “儿、儿子...”

    林峰的声音都发颤了。

    他活了三十多年，在石铁城见过的最高品质卡牌也不过是绿色。蓝色品质只在佣兵团里听说过，如今一下子见到这么多张，心脏狂跳得几乎要撞碎肋骨。

    “嗯？”

    林奇费力地掀开一只眼，浓重的疲惫感从眼底蔓延开来。

    昨晚为了融合卡牌，他几乎耗空了所有精神力，此刻脑袋里像塞了团棉花，又沉又胀。

    “爹，那八张魔法卡留下，潜行之靴和抗魔胸甲留一张给你，剩下的拿去卖…… 别叫我，我得补觉。”

    他含含糊糊地嘟囔完，眼皮就彻底沉了下去，显然是累到了极点。

    “这孩子，制卡再急也得顾着身子啊。”

    林峰叹了口气，语气里满是心疼，随后轻手轻脚地走到桌前查看。

    二十张一星器具卡斥候短刃整齐排开，卡面上的刃身纹路清晰锐利。

    两张二星佣兵大剑泛着厚重的绿光，卡面隐约能看到大剑砸落地面的虚影。八张爆裂火球则透着灼热的气息，仿佛下一秒就会喷出火焰。

    而最让他心跳加速的，是桌角那几张泛着蓝光的卡牌。

    一张幻影长剑的三星器具卡，剑身在薄雾中若隐若现，神秘又凌厉。四张潜行之靴暗纹流动，一看就适合刺杀潜行。还有一张抗魔胸甲和泛着特殊光泽的技能卡逐风三连斩。

    林峰屏住呼吸，小心翼翼地把所有卡牌收好，唯独将那八张爆裂火球放进桌面的木盒里，这才轻手轻脚地转身出门。

    他怕再晚一步，门外那群等得急了的人，真要把商铺的门板给拍碎了。

    ……

    刚拉开商铺的木门，一股夹杂着汗味与烟火气的热浪涌了进来，无数急切的声音瞬间将他淹没。

    “老板，我的佣兵佩剑呢？今天可别再卖完了！”

    “是啊是啊，我天没亮就来排队了！”
content_en:
On the second day,

It's not even bright yet, but there's already a long queue in front of the Wonderful Story store.

"Son! Get up quickly! If we wait a little longer, the group of people outside the door will probably demolish our shop!"

Lin Feng hurried into Lin Qi's room.

But as soon as he crossed the threshold, his steps seemed to be nailed to the ground, his rapid breathing suddenly stopped, and his eyes were fixed on the desk.

Three completely different rays of light circulated in the darkness, pure white, warm green, and a touch of blue like deep sea gems. Layers of cards covered half of the table.

"Son, son..."

Lin Feng's voice trembled.

He has lived for more than thirty years, and the highest quality cards he has ever seen in Shitie City are only green.Blue quality has only been heard of in the mercenary group. Now that I saw so many of them at once, my heart was beating so fast that I almost broke my ribs.

"Huh?"

Lin Qi struggled to open one eye, and a strong sense of fatigue spread from the bottom of his eyes.

In order to fuse the cards last night, he spent almost all his mental energy. At this moment, his head felt like a ball of cotton, heavy and swollen.

"Dad, keep the eight magic cards, leave one of the Stealth Boots and the Anti-Magic Breastplate for you, and sell the rest... Don't call me, I have to catch up on my sleep."

After he muttered vaguely, his eyelids sank completely, obviously he was extremely tired.

"This kid, no matter how urgent he is to make a card, he still has to take care of himself."

Lin Feng sighed, his tone full of distress, and then quietly walked to the table to check.

Twenty one-star equipment cards, Scout Short Blades, are arranged neatly, and the blade lines on the card surface are clear and sharp.

The two two-star mercenary swords glowed with a thick green light, and the shadow of the swords hitting the ground could be vaguely seen on the cards.The eight exploding fireballs exuded a scorching aura, as if they would emit flames in the next second.

What made his heart beat faster the most were the cards with blue light on the corner of the table.

A three-star instrument card for a phantom long sword. The sword is looming in the mist, mysterious and sharp.The four boots of stealth have flowing dark patterns, making them suitable for assassination and stealth at first glance.There is also an anti-magic breastplate and a special-glossy skill card called Zhufeng Triple Slash.

Lin Feng held his breath and carefully put away all the cards, except for the eight Exploding Fireballs, which he put into the wooden box on the table, and then he turned around and went out.

He was afraid that if he was one step too late, the group of people waiting impatiently outside the door would really smash the door panel of the shop into pieces.

…

As soon as he opened the wooden door of the shop, a wave of heat mixed with the smell of sweat and fireworks rushed in, and countless urgent voices instantly drowned him.

"Boss, where are my mercenary swords? Don't sell out again today!"

"Yes, yes, I came to line up before dawn!"
